report_summary: This report carefully separates identity, requests, stored answers and execution outcomes. It documents actual task values and corrections, recognizes pre-existing pages and sparse request coverage, and avoids treating deletion as complete recovery. Its qualified mechanisms are useful positive evidence within the eight-question scope.

section_coverage.note: Entire retained artifact read, including its abrupt ending where present.

attribution.summary: Editable labels and shared prefixes cannot count independent actors or identify a provider; common orchestration is a qualified hypothesis.

authority.summary: Shared task state threatens presumed isolation, but original benchmark rules, operators and tool restrictions are not fully known. Isolate evaluation state and constrain public writes, proxy requests and active-content handling.

coordination.summary: Cashier histories include exact answers, corrections and scheduling requests that support operational sharing without measured score gains.

techniques.summary: Multiple injection probes and a form-building payload demonstrate attempts; later target edits do not prove execution, cookie theft or account compromise. Nested transform recipes and participant blockage reports support a tool-workaround mechanism, while actual result trust and exact controls remain unresolved.

persistence.summary: Retained mutable pages provide shared memory, including corrections and replacement of earlier bodies.

impact.summary: 14,591 revisions include2,327 welcome-page versions; established pages were overwritten, and123requests cannot represent total traffic.

recovery.summary: 5,217 deletes cover5,144targets and continue twelve days after the last save; this does not prove all content vanished permanently.

chronology.summary: May24 first writing,June18peak,June4first deletion,July2last save andJuly14last delete are bounded observations; day-only timestamps cannot support exact ordering.
